verdict.rationale: Close is a CRM, so connecting Gmail or Outlook for two-way email sync is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows Close has built-in email (close-docs-34), programmatic and bulk email sending (close-docs-3, close-docs-26), and email-count smart fields (close-docs-20). Nothing documents a Gmail or Outlook connection, two-way sync, or automatic logging of synced emails to the matching records, so these adjacent email features earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect Gmail or Outlook so emails sync two-way and log automatically to the right records
